uwp_capture_status: partial: UWP launched (ok:true) and rendered correctly; initial Data Events frame captured as ground truth. The UWP CoreWindow's UIA subtree is not externally traversable (winapp inspect returns only a top-level Pane with no children), so title-driven navigation to scenario 2 and per-control actuation could not be driven via UI Automation. The Polling golden therefore still shows the Data Events page, and the __aNN after-click frames are duplicates. The sensor is also hardware-gated (status reads 'No altimeter found').

features.name: Scenario navigation list
features.description: Left-hand list lets the user switch between the two scenarios. Items are titled '1) Data Events' and '2) Polling'.
expected_behaviour: A selectable list shows '1) Data Events' and '2) Polling'
Selecting an item navigates the content pane to that scenario

features.name: Enable button (register altimeter reading-changed handler)
features.description: The Enable button is present and enabled by default. Clicking it acquires the default Altimeter and subscribes to ReadingChanged, then disables Enable and enables Disable.
expected_behaviour: An 'Enable' button is visible and enabled on the Data Events page
A 'Disable' button is visible (disabled until Enable is clicked)
Clicking Enable wires up the altimeter event handler (or reports 'No altimeter found' when no sensor)

features.name: Disable button (unsubscribe)
features.description: The Disable button stops the ReadingChanged subscription and re-enables Enable.
expected_behaviour: A 'Disable' button is visible on the Data Events page
Clicking Disable unsubscribes and re-enables the Enable button

features.name: Altitude change output
features.description: A text block reads 'Altitude change(m):' with the live value (or 'No data' before any reading).
expected_behaviour: An 'Altitude change(m):' label with a value field is visible
It updates as ReadingChanged events arrive

features.name: Get Data button (one-shot reading)
features.description: On the Polling page a 'Get Data' button reads the altimeter once and displays the current altitude change.
expected_behaviour: A 'Get Data' button is visible on the Polling page
Clicking it reads the altimeter once and updates the altitude output (or reports 'No altimeter found')

features.name: Status output region
features.description: A status region at the bottom shows 'Status:' plus a colored message such as 'No altimeter found'.
expected_behaviour: It reflects the current scenario state / error (e.g. 'No altimeter found')
